notes.title: Galaxy Tales 1.032 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello. Here's 1.032 update for Galaxy Tales.

Added input presets for the controller.

notes.content:
Improve Loading
Added Controller options
- Added Gamepad preset
Bosses revised
- Fixed: 5 Chapter boss' motion bug
- Added: 4 Chapter boss' new motion

- Adjusted: 2, 3, and 5 Chapter bosses' difficulty

Added/revised texts
- Modified English translation
Support controllers
- Supporting DualSense, DualShock 2 & 3
Fixed minor issues
